item_short_desc: Rothco’s Replacement Bite Valve fits any Rothco hydration pack or bladder. The bite valve is constructed from PVC plastic to prevent leaks and for a soft bite. The soft bite feature offers easier access to your fluids while hiking, biking or during other high-intensity activities.
